legend: The Moving Coffins of the Chase Vault (Barbados, 1812-1820)
lines: In Barbados, a sealed stone tomb kept a secret no one could explain.
The Chase family vault stood in a churchyard by the sea.
Each time it was opened for a burial, the heavy lead coffins were found tossed about.
It happened in eighteen twelve, then again, and again.
In eighteen twenty, the island's governor came to see for himself.
He had the floor sanded, the door sealed with cement, and his own mark pressed into it.
Legend says the seal stayed unbroken, yet the coffins lay scattered once more.
Nobody was ever blamed, and the vault was left empty.
Was it floods, thieves, or something else?
title: The Tomb Where Coffins Moved by Themselves #shorts
description:
In the 1800s, heavy lead coffins in a sealed Barbados vault were found thrown around again and again, even after the governor sealed the door.
